items.title: HOOD’s prediction markets to add $1.7B to revenue, exceed crypto by 2028: Bernstein

items.title: Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Buying, Spends $205M Buying Back STRC

items.title: Reflect Makes Branded Token Issuance Easier While Leaving The Collateral In Charge
items.summary: Reflect's Create launch, promoted by Solana on October 22, offers a fast route to issuing a branded yield-bearing token. The interface can simplify issuance, but the economics still come from the collateral behind the token and the way its interest is shared.
